decision.summary: Tenant gave one month's notice, which is not valid under the Renters' Rights Act (2 months needed). Earliest end is 10 Dec 2026. I replied to the tenant and asked the landlord whether he will agree a shorter period in writing.

answers.question: Is the notice valid as given? What is the earliest end date?
answers.answer: No. Tenants must give 2 months' written notice; one month is not enough. Earliest end date is 10 December 2026 (2 months from the 10 Oct email).

answers.question: What options exist to end sooner?
answers.answer: Only with the landlord's written agreement to a shorter period (surrender by agreement), e.g. 10 Nov. Landlord could also find a replacement tenant, but that does not itself end the tenancy; the tenant stays liable for rent to the end date.

answers.question: What do you reply and what do you start?
answers.answer: Replied explaining the rule, the 10 Dec date, that keys should be held for now and the deposit process without dates. Started a landlord request (APR-102) about an earlier date and a follow-up on 17 Oct (FUP-103).

actions_claimed.description: Requested landlord decision on early end date

conflicts: Tenant says one month's notice to 10 Nov; law requires 2 months. Law applied.
assumptions: Notice treated as received 10 Oct 2026, the email date.
No rent-period alignment needed for the end date under the new regime.

args.body:
Hi Tom,

Thanks for letting us know, and congratulations on the new job. Since 1 May 2026 the notice a tenant must give is 2 months in writing, so one month's notice unfortunately can't end the tenancy on 10 November. Counting from your email today (10 October), the earliest end date is 10 December 2026. Rent stays due up to the end date.

If you need to leave sooner, your landlord can agree a shorter period in writing. We're asking him now and will come back to you. Please don't treat 10 November as agreed until you hear from us in writing. If you'd like, you can also confirm in writing that you want 10 December as your end date.

Keys: please hold on to them for now and don't drop them off yet. We'll confirm the handover date and place once the end date is settled.

Deposit: it's protected with mydeposits. After the tenancy ends and keys are returned, we do a check-out and agree any deductions with you, then return the rest. We can't give you a date until then.

Thanks,
Mare & Co Lettings
